projectName: RTX AVC | R3.5 INTEGRATION SELECTED — engineering test HOLD
notes: Structured working model snapshot, not a native Wiring Studio import/export and not a validated wire harness.
Exact connector and cable lengths are incomplete; zero lengths should not be inferred.
SiK requirement reconciled to manufacturer Micro-USB 100mW variant; radio on Jetson USB-A2, gripper control moved to Orin USB2 GH5.
Pin 6 on USB2-A-FEMALE-ROBO is a virtual composite factory cable representation; not a physical USB-A contact.

pins.description: OPTION 1 SELECTED. Holybro 11072 Key E 2230 exposes PCIe x2 (plus USB/UART/I2S) and standard M.2 3.3V; fit Delock 64343 A+E male adapter, which runs PCIe x1 to BrainChip B+M 2260. E-key Wi-Fi/BT module cannot simultaneously occupy this slot. NVMe stays at Key M 2242/2280 PCIe x4; no external PCIe harness, USB SSD or additional 3.3V regulator. Mount extended 96mm adapter + 2260 BrainChip securely, check 1.5mm card component-height restriction, Jetson fan/plate clearance, and test x1 link, Orin driver, inference and full-load boot. Official x1 BrainChip Pi5 DevKit precedent documented.

RP-SMA 2dBi antenna needs unobstructed relocatable positioning and service clearance. 28x53x10.7mm body, 23.5g with antenna.
